svg.title: Tabby AI Tools v0.8.1 interface illustration — conditional interactive workflows, helper models, local login and API connections
svg.desc: Shared Codex/Claude CLI discovery prevents startup cancellation races; clipboard attachments with inline previews and native tab progress; custom instructions/private CLI session spaces and Pi configuration: native provider search, offline SDK 1.4.0 catalog, four custom protocols and Save/Discard/Copy drafts. Interface illustration, not a running screenshot. Windows default Codex discovery compares actual CLI versions across PATH and desktop/standalone installations; a stable directory limits selection to its own children. Conditional recordings preserve interaction intent; local rules run first, with an optional current-connection helper model and rebind-before-resume checkpoints. Settings use two-row connection cards and editor summaries, compact headings and full-page scrolling for connections, workflows/preferences and scheduled tasks, with no fixed-height editor. The assistant sidebar coordinates example staging database and application terminals. Connection and model controls share one compact row. Scheduled tasks, provider connections, startup opening enabled by default and twelve interface languages and the Claude Code local-login connection are shown below. Active goals continue automatically by default. Thinking and tool calls appear as collapsed conversation entries that can be expanded. Terminal reads return early after reliable shell completion. Terminal output is read on demand without automatic forwarding; a completed explicit recording and a saved workflow alias are shown. Archive status distinguishes successful checkpoints from successful persistence. Pi runtime settings show the built-in runtime and an optional Node override, host-only tools and opt-in automatic context compaction. The provider list includes Kimi and Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan connections. Custom OpenAI-compatible settings show an example Base URL, model, protocol and authentication. Version 0.8.1 example with optional Pi SDK runtime, built-in Node 22.19+, manual context compaction and structured retry waiting.
